name: Brie
siboNotes: As an aged soft cheese, brie is naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. The aging process reduces lactose content significantly.
preparationTips: Allow to come to room temperature for best flavor and texture
Remove rind if you prefer, though it's edible and adds flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP crackers made from rice or corn
Store properly wrapped in refrigerator and consume within a few days of opening
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in phosphorus for bone health
